scripts.generate:ts: json2ts -i 'events/*.json' -o src/generated --cwd events && sed -i.bak 's/export const enum/export enum/g' src/generated/*.ts && rm -f src/generated/*.bak
scripts.generate:py: mkdir -p python && uv run --with datamodel-code-generator datamodel-codegen --input events --output python --input-file-type jsonschema
